svg.title: A collaborative global offer
svg.desc: Europe and international partners contribute standards and interoperability profiles while participants retain authority; connecting lines represent a proposed cooperation model. Europe can turn its dataspace experience into a globally collaborative offer. International partners contribute to shared standards and jointly governed interoperability profiles while participants retain local authority. The illustration is a proposed cooperation model. Diplomatic agreements, technical interoperability, accepted issuer authority and legal recognition are separate achievements; their completion is not implied by the connecting lines.
